Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Membership in the Emerald Enclave
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 2
Order: Recruit

Veteran Emerald Enclave agents create havens of trees, grass, and flowing water where magical creatures of nature live in peace. The grove can house one Huge creature or two Large creatures; four Small or Medium creatures or eight Tiny creatures take the space of one Large creature.

Recruit: Creature of Nature. You invite a creature from the table below. Roll any die: on an odd number, nothing comes of it; on an even number, a creature accepts and moves in after 7 days. Your hirelings care for it and keep up the facility.

Creatures in the grove count as Bastion Defenders; remove those you lose from your roster. You can choose not to count some of them, in which case they can't be called on to defend the Bastion and act according to their nature, using their Monster Manual stat blocks.
